questions.why: Albert Francis Simmons, a government assassin from Detroit, becomes Spawn.

questions.q: Which demon makes the deal that returns Al as a Hellspawn?
questions.why: Al strikes a deal with Malebolgia, returns as a Hellspawn, and discovers he has been dead for five years.

questions.q: Which Image Comics co-founder created Spawn?
questions.why: Todd McFarlane created Spawn and published him through Image Comics.
Spawn's hellish abilities are powered by necroplasm.

questions.q: Which former best friend of Al marries his widow Wanda?
questions.why: Wanda marries Terry, and the two have a daughter named Cyan.

questions.q: In what year did Spawn #1 appear?
questions.why: Spawn #1 came out in May 1992 and sold about 1.7 million copies.

questions.q: Which actor starred in the 1997 live-action Spawn film?
questions.why: Michael Jai White played Spawn in the 1997 live-action film.

questions.q: Which landmark Spawn release in 2019 broke Cerebus's record for the longest-running creator-owned superhero series?
questions.why: Spawn #301 arrived in 2019, one past Cerebus's 300, and Guinness certified it as a record for a creator-owned superhero run.

questions.q: Who voices Spawn in HBO's 1997 animated series?
questions.why: Keith David voices Spawn in HBO's Todd McFarlane's Spawn, which ran from 1997 to 1999.

questions.q: Neil Gaiman sued the series' creator over characters from which Spawn issue?
questions.why: Gaiman's lawsuit concerned Spawn #9 characters and ended in 2012.
